objective: Close final 3 correctness and continuous-verification gaps in ForgeLoop PoC: host-independent path safety including Windows drive-absolute/UNC, cross-file productionReadiness semantic consistency, and first-class GitHub Actions CI matrix verification.

assumptions.value: Original protocol-authoritative task-state files under poc/evidence/poc-20260826-real-execution/task-state/ remain immutable historical evidence.
assumptions.reason: Preserving genuine historical execution evidence is essential to protocol integrity and non-fabrication.

assumptions.value: Post-publication E_RECEIPT_PATH_MISMATCH artifacts remain preserved as intentional fail-closed drift evidence.
assumptions.reason: Retaining negative evidence demonstrates ForgeLoop changed-path detection when unsealed files are added after receipt compilation.

deliverables: Host-independent path safety rejecting Windows drive-absolute, UNC, and device paths on every host in scripts/verify_poc_evidence.mjs.
Cross-file productionReadiness semantic consistency assertions across manifest.json, completion.json, and publication.json in scripts/verify_poc_evidence.mjs.
Dedicated npm run poc:evidence:test script in package.json.
Expanded regression test suite in poc/test/poc-evidence-publication.test.js covering host-independent paths and productionReadiness consistency.
Continuous execution of poc:evidence:verify and poc:evidence:test across Node 20, 22, 24 in .github/workflows/docs-quality.yml.
constraints: Do not reopen, overwrite, or fabricate original execution artifacts under task-state/.
Do not claim production readiness or universal tamper resistance.
Do not introduce external runtime npm dependencies.
Preserve all English-only documentation and source code requirements.
risks: Host-specific path.isAbsolute behavior could allow Windows drive-absolute or UNC paths to bypass validation on non-Windows hosts.
Inconsistent productionReadiness enum values between files could lead to ambiguous public status.

verification.text: npm run poc:evidence:verify validates the published evidence package and exits 0.
npm run poc:evidence:test validates all failure modes with 0 failures.
npm test and workload tests pass cleanly.
npm run lint passes with 0 errors.
npm run coverage satisfies coverage thresholds.
npm run docs:check and documentation conformance pass.

successCriteria: Evidence verifier rejects Windows drive-absolute and UNC paths on every host OS.
productionReadiness is strictly consistent across manifest, completion, and publication files.
npm run poc:evidence:test is registered and executed in GitHub Actions Node matrix.
All local and CI checks pass with exit code 0.
stopConditions: Unresolvable hash or structural discrepancy discovered in historical task-state evidence.
ForgeLoop preflight or completion validator fails.
